name: Glowing footprint mat
subtitle: shows a diabetic's foot pressure hot spots

effects.effect: some solids give off light when squeezed or strained

effect: some solids give off light when squeezed or strained
how: Diabetes numbs the feet, so pressure spots go unfelt until they turn into ulcers, the main cause of amputations, and the electronic plates that find them are too costly for most clinics. This clear rubber mat is filled with crystals that glow when squeezed (mechanoluminescence); a patient walks across it in a dim room and a phone camera underneath records where the footprint glows brightest.
obstacle: The glow is faint, so the mat must shine brightly enough for a phone camera and read the same after thousands of steps.
why: Cheap pressure maps could prevent many of the million-plus diabetic amputations each year.
real: An NUS 2026 Nature Communications mechano-electroluminescent e-skin maps plantar pressure visually for gait and diabetic-ulcer risk, but it is electrically driven rather than self-glowing mechanoluminescent crystals; no ML footprint mat found.
